text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we took it down!
──Wait, it's still moving!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
倒したわ！
──って、あいつ！　
まだ動くの！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like it's over yet.
The opponent doesn't appear to stop until it's destroyed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで一件落着、
とはいかなそうだね。
相手さん、
ぶっ壊れるまで止まる様子はなさそうだ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Is it planning to fire those beams again as it retreats?
I hope we're not in for a drawn-out chase in this vast desert...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつ、
逃げた先からまたあの光線を撃ってくる気？
この
だだっ広い砂漠で追いかけっこなんて、
勘弁してほしいわよ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
But letting those beams rain down is no joke either?
We have to take it down. Let's chase after it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど放っておいて、
光線の雨あられってのも笑えないだろう？
アタシたちで倒すしかないさ。
後を追うよ。
